basis.prior_prices: Ten of 49 owners have other direct changed results. The other 39 previously cost 424.12M and 423.42M guest instructions. Missing, zero and transitive inputs can still force recomputation. No portion of these historical prices counts as a measured benefit.

hardware.build_guard: paired #20992 ordinary build fixed Cargo and actual linked consumer; practical guard requires each four-pair hold median candidate/control <1.05 and a one-sided exact sign p<=0.05 below a 1.10 wall ratio. A wall gain or cold-build claim needs its own positive evidence.
hardware.combined_twenty_percent: Measure the release-optimized combined stack directly against its 77ce pre-derive parent in 8 separately balanced pairs. Claim a >=20% terminal cut only with each hold median below 0.80 and one-sided exact sign p<=0.05 vs 0.80. No cross-study multiplication.
hardware.large_endpoints: Cumulative 2x ordinary Cargo wall on #22958 or total rustc instructions on #21041 require an actual direct corrected -22 to combined stack comparison, eight prospectively balanced pairs all strictly above 2x, two holds. A hardware instructions result does not establish elapsed time.
hardware.marginal: Require each four-pair hold median below 0.95 for terminal candidate/parent and exact one-sided sign p<=0.05 at 0.95; simultaneously require sum of all 8 per pair to improve with each hold median below 1 and sign p<=0.05 vs 1. Report the full panel, even if either fails.
hardware.scope: Then run the exact release-optimized source change directly against the corresponding generated-impl-only production compiler; all eight prespecified complete process observations and wall time retained. Native opening, both source states, clocks and original PMU records must pass.

prior_to_screen: Document source and compiler fixtures for actual bd03 baseline plus candidate, including owning crate and linked ordinary installed toolchain.

Run accepted, denied and overflow cases through A, unchanged A, warm B, cold B, changed-bound C; verify output, error category, all messages and rendered foreign bound location under both legacy and next solvers. Distinguish next-solver warnings with exit zero.

Keep the two-crate native semantic gate. Baseline has three type-check roots on A, zero on unchanged A, three on moved-span B. Require a reduction in these providers on B and intact changed-bound refusals.

Validate format compatibility from the actual code change, including cached errors. If a serialization epoch must be retired, test both directions and that independently built affected outputs match true clean results.

On each real paired #21041 source opening require all 37 typed workspace outputs, eight matching real compiler commands, matching crate headers, dependency identities, DefPath keys and descriptors, reachable definition records, hygiene/expansion records and typed const-allocation contents, PyPI/Pyx linked A/warm-B/clean-B witness, and six stable generated impls. Re-run both sides with fixed signed Cargo.

screen.advance: Terminal candidate/parent <=0.95 and sum of all eight strictly decreases in both independently prepared pairs. At least one real Archive owner skips its previously observed typeck or borrowck query; show full membership of the original 49 and 97.
screen.candidate: direct child with only the measured span-independent solver change, commit recorded before any counter
screen.guards: Empty incremental A/clean B real terminal instructions as in the prior protocol. Stop on repeated >2% growth on either state. Repeat the ordinary four-file #20992 build on both SDKs with actual linked A/B behavior, same-target native outputs and existing per-compiler archive oracle. A repeated >=10% build regression stops promotion.
screen.measure: Callgrind real userspace instructions of all eight Cargo-dispatched compilers after the actual edit. Report terminal uv_client and every crate, plus the sum. Rebuild both independent A histories and take the first edited invocation.

source_scope: Use ordered semantic where clauses in concrete trait-impl confirmation and retain fresh bound locations on diagnostic demand. No change to the meaning or hash of spanful predicates. Keep linked semantics, normalization order, hygiene, all diagnostic locations, explicit caller spans and ordinary compiler defaults. No extra result cache.
status: prospective; chosen after the native first-veto trace, before compilation of a changed solver
